title: [SUBS] Raygun: Breaking Badly (Untold) Documentary Coming to Netflix 1st September @ Netflix
body:
Deal: [SUBS] Raygun: Breaking Badly (Untold) Documentary Coming to Netflix 1st September @ Netflix

[banana365] I doubt the complaint is about a streaming video service, it's more likely the content of the streaming video or, even more likely, the idiotic subject of the documentary.
[Qmar] Especially since we are giving attention to a person who does not deserve it!
[QuickToThePointless] Raygun is no more an Olympian than breakdancing is an Olympic sport.
[darthsparrow] Actually, the GOLD MEDAL question is, how did this get on Netflix?
[Frackingiscool] Hopefully she goes to jail for trying to sanction a hit on a competing tiger sanctuary or something.
[pharcyde] "memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there."
Sounds like more HR-ified slop from Netflix.
[Fooah] Cannot wait for this, easily my favourite olympian ever. Thanks OP!
[starbearer] but if it made you laugh than whats so bad about that?
it wasn't intended to make us laugh!
it was supposed to be a representation of our country as a whole on the world stage and made us a laughing stock.
Although I do appreciate the post and will try and check the documentary out
[Maxeyboy18] Problem is watching this junk is just building her platform and supporting people like her.
Vote with your (non) views.
Hope it flops.
[krushgroove] If 'Raygun' (ugh what a stupid name) made you laugh fine, but that’s an incredibly low bar for an Olympian. The Olympics aren’t supposed to be a comedy showcase. They’re supposed to represent the best a country can produce. She took Australia’s one place in that event, a place that could have gone to another breaker capable of showcasing the sport at an elite level and inspiring the next generation. Instead, Australia’s Olympic breaking moment became an international embarrassment. “At least she made people laugh” isn’t a defence.
[DrScavenger] We had a very successful year too. But now Australia in that year will only be known by that "performance". Singlehandedly overshadowed everyone's success. It's kinda impressive, really.
[slipperypete] That's because you are a decent human who doesn't take life too hard or too serious
[iWan] Made us laugh… What’s so bad about that?
Holy crap. It’s the Olympics! The elite of the elite!
Completely ridiculous inclusion that I’m sure cost Australian tax payers plenty.
[QuickToThePointless] Yep - Cathy Freeman should have kangaroo hopped the entire 400m back in Sydney 2000.
Now she's our second best.
[Gunnar] She’s no Bradbury. That guy personifies the two greatest words in the English language: de fault
[CptnObvious] People will pay for her to reenact her Olympic feat…in more weird ways.
[Water Bearer] She has done OF back in 2020. Nobody wants to see that anyway!
[gviddy] Does she still threaten to sue everyone if they mention her name or post photos/video of her?
[onlinepred] That sucks she is getting rewarded for being bad
[G4mbito] Says the Bogan… It was the Olympics not the wet shirt contest at you local pub
[slipperypete] she worked for a while as a Pole dancer but wasn't very good at it
[TheDukeOfNukem] I also can't breakdance. Where's my Netflix contract?
[UnrealMacaw] I honestly don't understand why people want to give her airtime. If she'd turned up for swimming or archery with no skill, we'd be shocked. Why are we happy to treat breakdancing like a joke?
[banana365] You may not like or appreciate the Olympics. That's fine. However lowly you think of them, the expectation is that those who compete are at the top of their game in their country. This woman was not even playing the same game. She changed the rules so that she got to play with the big boys and embarrassed herself. It's bad enough what she did to get there, but at some point she must have looked at what others were doing and thought to herself "yeah, I'm at that level." We sent an idiot to the Olympics.
[not ai] It's not just about blocking this post. It's literally as a country we shouldn't put up with such rubbish particularly when it tarnished the Australia's name and wasted tax payer money. I'd rather watch a doco on Cathy Freeman.
[M911] where this guy's documentary
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/zetjG-5JBk4
[banana365] Eddie the Eagle was an odd one. He wasn't great, but he was genuinely the best the UK had to offer and worked his arse off to get to the Olympics. Despite his lack of success, he is certainly someone whose dedication is to be admired. He also seems like he's a decent bloke who didn't take himself as seriously as Raygun and could handle the jokes at his expense.
[maverickjohn] Watch Australia's embarassment. No thanks.
I have a lot of Aussie pride but I don't waste that pride on people who humiliate our country
[sistermay] She doesNOT show the Aussie side as not so many Aussies are as low as she is, she's a SCAM !!!
[tubeidea] She rorted and grifted, as is the (modern) Australian way.
[gromit] She was a cheat and a pathetic individual. While I don't care for breakdancing and it was dumb to be in the Olympics she took the place that should have gone to someone with actual skills and embarrassed the country. She did not show the Aussie side at all, she insulted the world and Australia.
[Serapis] That wasn't her point though, she was 100% serious and tried to sue a comedy club and parody show for making fun of her.
[pat0809] Didn't her production team or management have something to do with this being made?

[Pace210] For someone not all that flexible, she certainly (profanity) herself.

[life is suffering] Some people are so far behind in the race , they believe that are winning 😭
